text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: Oh? Knight-kyun, for real? Like, for-real-for-real? You want Big Sis Nea?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お？
騎士きゅん、
マジ？　
マジマジのマジ？
ネアおねえちゃんがいーの？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: Nfufufufu~ So that's how it is, huh~♪ Damn, I'm so freaking happy~ We're seriously, totally into each other~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンフフフフ～　
そっかそっか～♪
やべー　
超うれし～　
ガチ両想いじゃ～ん♡

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: Nfufu~ Knight-kyun turned his love into something real like this, and somehow... it gave me a little courage boost~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ンフフ～
騎士きゅんがこーやってラブを形にしてくれて、
な～んか勇気もらっちった♡

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: Maan, this is too good~♡ So freaking good♡ I'm seriously hyped right now~ Guess love really does transcend your usual type and all your little kinks, huh~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
は～～
やば♡　
やっば♡
マ～ジでアガるわ～
やっぱラブは、
好みのタイプとか
セーヘキとか
超えちゃうんだなーって。

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: My chest gets all tingly right here, and then it gets suuuper warm... It's kinda different from when my "shota-sensor" goes ping☆, y'know? I guess this is what they mean by being seriously in love, or having a real crush, or... something like that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
胸のこのへんが、
きゅーんってして、
め～っちゃあったかくなって……
ショタセンサーがピコン☆　
ってすんのとは
ちょい違うっつーか。
きっと、
マジ好きとかガチ恋とか、
そーゆうカンジ？　
みたいな？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: I mean, getting showered with love by my crush like this~ It's a first for me, y'know♡ Aaaah, I can't stop swooning~ Seriously, thanks a million, Knight-kyun♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
てか～　
好きぴにちゅきちゅきされるとか～
ハジメテの経験なんだが♡　
や～んキュン止まんね～
マジあんがとね
騎士きゅん♡

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: ...Well, if there's any obstacle in our way, I guess it'd be introducing a polyandrous system~ Though who knows how many years it'll be before that happens and if it even does with Kariza-kyun. But the three of us are "Love♡Forever", right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ま、
壁があるとすんなら、
一妻多夫制の導入ぐらいか～
カリザきゅんとも、
何年後になるかわかんねーけど。
でも、
アタシら３人は
『らぶ♡ふぉーえばー』だし？

text_block_list.name: Nea
text_block_list.text: We can totally overcome whatever comes next if we join forces, right♪ But first... Knight-kyun! Let me give you a hug~♡ Ugh, I seriously love you so much~♪ *Kiss kiss*~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
この先だって、
力合わせて乗り越えてイケるっしょ♪
とりま騎士きゅん。
ハグさせて～♡
もー　
マジ大好き～♪　
ちゅっちゅ～♡
